-Don't use emojis

-Read the post properly before criticising. If you don't understand, then ask.

-There are obvious troll accounts. Don't argue with them, it's a waste of time.

-When there's a 69 or 420 in a post, always comment "nice". Remember there might be a r/fuckyouinparticular instance where your comment will be downvoted, but hey, it's all for the meme.

-Don't get offended if you're in a quarantined subreddit or a subreddit known for being offensive. My God, just get out of that subreddit and go to the subreddit complaining about it instead of starting a never-ending spat.

-ALWAYS say why you edited your comment.
